worlds.name: Two Eyes
worlds.teaser: A river turns brown. One eye on the ground, one in orbit, and the mud finally has an address.
worlds.body: Someone films a muddy river on their phone. Two Eyes looks upstream through Sentinel-2, finds the fresh mining scar, and folds both into a dated evidence card anyone can share. Made for the Meta Global AI Developer Hackathon, 2026.

worlds.name: Atmo
worlds.body: Article 6, loss and damage, adaptation finance: the questions that usually need a policy brief and an afternoon. Atmo answers them plainly and keeps its answers grounded.

worlds.name: VentureQuest
worlds.teaser: Run a climate startup. Survive your own decisions.
worlds.body: A game where you found a climate venture and live with every trade-off real founders face, one decision at a time.

worlds.name: Carbon Markets for SMEs
worlds.teaser: Who gets a seat at the carbon table?
worlds.body: Ongoing research into what it would take for small Ghanaian businesses and communities to enter carbon markets on their own terms, not someone else's.

worlds.name: notify-crossx
worlds.teaser: Step away. It'll call you back.
worlds.body: Your AI coding agent works while you make tea. notify-crossx pings your desktop when it's done or needs you, and stays quiet while you're watching. Free for OpenCode, with a Claude Code edition.
